Viewing aids
Layout and tools
Photos and camera video
Use the round shutter button to take photos or start and stop video. Hold to focus, release to shoot, and slide off the button to cancel.
Live view gestures
With subject tracking, tap the image to choose a subject; tap again to cancel tracking. Pinch to zoom, drag when zoomed in, and double-tap to reset.
Exposure controls
Hold and drag a dial vertically to quickly adjust exposure compensation, ISO, aperture or shutter speed. The AUTO button on the ISO dial toggles Auto ISO.
Review
In photo mode, view the latest photo: swipe to browse, pinch or double-tap to zoom, and tap to close. JPG+NEF files with the same name share one preview.
Connection and battery
Connection status is at the top; the battery shows the remaining charge.
Change monitor resolution without changing camera photo or video quality.
Show how many frames the monitor receives each second, not the camera recording frame rate.
Show camera left and right audio levels. Available only in video mode.
See brightness distribution: dark on the left, bright on the right. Tap to cycle through RGB (red, green, blue), luminance and off.
Choose guides to help frame your shot.
Zebra marks bright areas; false color uses colors to show brightness. Tap to cycle through both modes and off.
For anamorphic lenses, widen the image to match the lens ratio. Use 1× for ordinary lenses.
Show camera tilt to help keep the image level.
Adjust camera white balance.
Choose the area used for focusing, such as a single point or wide area.
Horizontal positions match the image; higher traces mean brighter values. Tap to cycle through luminance, RGB and off.
Choose single, continuous, manual or other focus modes.
Show or hide the focus frame.
Choose a folder with .cube files. One level of subfolders forms categories. Only monitor colors change; camera photos and videos are unaffected. Cannot be used with false color.
Switch between existing presets, or tap the pencil for a slot to replace or clear it. Use built-in presets or .np3 files in a folder. Flexible Color .np3 files are not yet supported.
Read the camera exposure indicator to judge whether exposure is too bright or dark.
Fix the current screen orientation; unlock to rotate again. Shooting controls are unaffected.
Some cameras offer more adjustable settings when enabled, but camera-body controls may be limited. Leaving the monitor releases control.
Switch between portrait and either landscape direction. Unlock orientation first if locked.

Manage tool visibility and order: drag to reorder and tap to show or hide. Photo and video layouts are remembered separately. Hiding a viewing aid disables it. Lock and rotation cannot be moved or hidden.
Landscape DISP
Switch the information shown on the monitor image.
